prompt_text:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens and shallow depth of field, with natural skin tones in soft warm practical lighting. A medium close-up frames a Chinese woman in her late twenties with long straight dark hair in a natural side part, minimal makeup and a warm, understated expression, wearing a loose beige T-shirt under a muted brown pinafore dress, from the chest up, seated at a wooden table in a softly lit home interior in the evening and turned three-quarters toward the right. An open silver laptop stands on the table in front of her, its screen facing her and away from the camera, with a ceramic mug beside it; a warm floor lamp glows behind her at the left and a shelf with a few books and a small plant is softly out of focus. At the start her eyes are on the laptop screen, reading, and she blinks once. On the table beside the laptop, a smartphone lying face up lights up with a soft glow and gives a single short vibration. Her eyes move from the laptop to the phone; she picks it up with her right hand, the screen facing her and away from the camera, and reads. A gentle, warm smile appears and stays, and she makes one small thumb movement on the screen. Her long dark hair falls naturally over one shoulder; both eyes stay level and symmetrical and she never looks into the lens. The camera holds a static shot. Her lips stay closed; she does not speak. There is no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet domestic room tone, one soft notification chime with a short buzz of the phone on the wooden table, and the faint rustle of her sleeve as she picks it up.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
